{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, with the latest test

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) so highest sample_seq comes first
# Then drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the first (i.e., highest sample_seq)
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Count the number of unique patients
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Print the result
num_patients"}
